'''November 2000 Parker tournament (25 November)''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Parker, CO on 25 November 2000. [[Brian Hunter]] won it. It is known from Brian Hunter's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1495">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-11-26-parker-co-11-25-00-the-saga-continuesd1495/ parker-co-11-25-00-the-saga-continues], DeckTech (Brian "HuntaWarya" Hunter, 26 November 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-11-26-parker-co-11-25-00-the-saga-continuesd1495/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 25 November 2000
* '''Site:''' Parker, CO
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Jabba's Palace Sealed Deck]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Brian Hunter]]
